name: Timed multi-track composition
acceptance_test: Three scenario groups activate at configured 0s, 60s, and 120s active-time offsets and retain those offsets in provenance and archives.

name: Reusable clips in compositions
acceptance_test: One stored script can be referenced by multiple scenario groups without copying or mutating its source revision.

name: Sequenced and parallel containers
acceptance_test: Sequential actions preserve order and an approved bounded parallel block emits deterministic branch and container metrics.

name: Page document and resource model
acceptance_test: An HTTP document and its static or dynamic resources share page hierarchy and render as one rollup plus a resource waterfall.

name: Count, foreach, while, and parallel repeats
acceptance_test: Count, foreach, while, and scenario iterations pass runtime tests; parallel-repeat VUser distribution remains partial until fixture-proven and implemented.

name: Conditional if and switch branching
acceptance_test: The first matching CEL switch case executes, the default executes when none match, and every branch is traversed by policy tooling.

name: Scenario composition timeline
acceptance_test: Timeline and form/JSON editing round-trip offsets, ramps, pacing, locations, roles, and script references without field loss.

name: Test-scoped elastic grid lifecycle
acceptance_test: An ephemeral run provisions, becomes ready, executes, drains, and deprovisions without deleting capacity before archive terminality.

name: Multi-cloud generator locations
acceptance_test: Every advertised provider or registered Kubernetes target reports honest capabilities and per-location allocation evidence.

name: Prepare without target traffic
acceptance_test: Local HTTP/TCP counters verify traffic-free preparation; immutable capacity-policy and ECS spot floor/ceiling tests pass. Live acceptance across every provider/runtime remains required.

name: Live and archived regional analytics
acceptance_test: A two-region distributed run has identical bounded live and archive regional totals.

name: Message-level request and response drill-down
acceptance_test: An authorized operator can move from a chart bucket to a bounded transaction sample and inspect redacted evidence.

name: Network waterfall analysis
acceptance_test: HTTP and browser network entries render DNS, connect, TLS, TTFB, transfer, and resource timing without inventing missing phases.

name: Hierarchy and phase filters
acceptance_test: Archive queries filter by bounded hierarchy and closed stage or annotation phase ranges.

name: Network profile analytics dimension
acceptance_test: Live and archived metrics split by configured network profile with bounded labels.

name: Error analysis dashboard
acceptance_test: Errors are classified, filterable, and linked to root-cause and transaction evidence.

name: Multi-result and baseline comparison
acceptance_test: Pinned baselines and release trends compare compatible runs with explicit missing-data warnings.

name: Composable metric widgets and overlays
acceptance_test: A saved panel can select an approved metric, dimension, filter, overlay, and bounded series count for live and archive data.

name: Shared dashboards and slideshows
acceptance_test: A project editor saves a versioned dashboard that a second viewer can read while private local drafts remain private.

name: Bounded response property analytics
acceptance_test: An operator explicitly promotes a non-sensitive extraction, cardinality is capped, and overflow aggregates into other.

name: Private-network infrastructure monitors
acceptance_test: Signed run jobs, sealed credentials, SSH host-key rejection, authenticated OTLP, and restricted TLS JMX/PostgreSQL fixtures are covered. Broader private-network and cloud acceptance remains required.

name: External metrics and bounded log events
acceptance_test: An approved source contributes bounded metrics or redacted events to live and archived analysis.

name: Result-to-monitor and monitor-to-monitor correlation
acceptance_test: Two monitor series and one result series align on the same run clock and expose missing or stale samples.

name: Live ramp control with tentative preview
acceptance_test: A pending runtime adjustment previews target load, duration, capacity, conflicts, and revision before apply.

name: Direct database load
acceptance_test: Database query, execution, procedure, and transaction actions retain session ownership and metrics.

name: First-class WebSocket actions
acceptance_test: Open, send, receive, and close actions execute with bounded messages and transaction telemetry.

name: JMS messaging
acceptance_test: Each advertised broker adapter reports whether it is real, sidecar-backed, or mock-only and passes its opt-in integration suite.

name: Adaptive streaming and multi-CDN load
acceptance_test: A bounded HLS or DASH playback walks manifests and segments and reports startup, bitrate, buffer, rebuffer, CDN, and region evidence.

name: Protocol extension and result injection
acceptance_test: Compiled protocol registrations and governed external runners emit standard bounded APEX results.

name: CLI automation and transaction gates
acceptance_test: CLI run or wait emits stable JSON and JUnit and fails on an exact named transaction rule.

name: Word reports and per-widget exports
acceptance_test: Every report profile exports DOCX and every quantitative chart exports raw CSV plus PNG or SVG.

name: CloudTest XML and repository export migration
acceptance_test: Three sanitized dependency-complete golden exports have zero unclassified known elements, retain unknown path/type evidence, and one exact composition batch-commits and executes.

name: Native mobile application automation
acceptance_test: TouchTest assets import as disclosure-safe review evidence and cannot launch without a separately approved runtime.

name: RUM and synthetic pairing
acceptance_test: No support claim is raised until a current documented API, privacy contract, fixture, and customer-backed use case exist.
